title: Counterfactual Probing for the Influence of Affect and Specificity on Intergroup Bias

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model predictions of in-group versus out-group social relationships (operationalized via US political party affiliations of Congress members) by using counterfactual probing (AlterRep/Iterative Nullspace Projection) to manipulate pragmatic language features like affect and specificity.
